# Local Emergency Electrician

> Licensed electrical contractor based in Los Angeles, CA. We handle emergency electrical repairs, panel upgrades, rewiring, EV charger installation, generators, surge protection and lighting for homes, commercial spaces and multifamily properties. Call 1-844-957-4676.

Business details:
- Address: 2701 S Figueroa St, Los Angeles, CA 90007
- Phone: +1-844-957-4676
- Hours: Monday to Saturday, 8:00 AM to 6:00 PM (closed Sunday)
- Founded: 2011 in Los Angeles, CA, by Jennifer
- Payments: Visa, Mastercard, American Express, Discover, PayPal, Cash
- Price range: $$
- Service model: headquartered in Los Angeles; services outside the Los Angeles area are delivered through contractor agreements with local licensed electricians.
- Coverage: 10,633 cities across 49 states and the District of Columbia.

## Main pages
- [Home](https://localemergencyelectrician.com/): Overview of services and how to book
- [All Services](https://localemergencyelectrician.com/services/): Full list of electrical services
- [About](https://localemergencyelectrician.com/about): Company background
- [Contact](https://localemergencyelectrician.com/contact): Request a quote or service call

## Repair and installation
- [Electrical Repairs](https://localemergencyelectrician.com/services/electrical-repairs): Troubleshooting, outages, breakers, faulty wiring, emergency callouts
- [Electrical Installation](https://localemergencyelectrician.com/services/electrical-installation): New circuits, outlets, switches, fixtures, fans, detectors
- [Switches and Outlets](https://localemergencyelectrician.com/services/switches-outlets): GFCI, AFCI, USB outlets, dimmers, smart switches
- [Lighting and Fixtures](https://localemergencyelectrician.com/services/lighting-electrical-fixtures): Recessed, outdoor, chandeliers, ceiling fans

## Panels and wiring
- [Panel Upgrades](https://localemergencyelectrician.com/services/electrical-panel-upgrades): Breaker panel and service upgrades
- [Wiring and Rewiring](https://localemergencyelectrician.com/services/electrical-wiring): New circuits, 240V, whole-home rewiring
- [Baseboard and Wall Heaters](https://localemergencyelectrician.com/services/baseboard-wall-heaters): Heater wiring and dedicated circuits

## Power and protection
- [EV Charger Installation](https://localemergencyelectrician.com/services/ev-charger-installation): Level 2 and Tesla home chargers
- [Generator Services](https://localemergencyelectrician.com/services/generator-services): Standby and whole-home generators, transfer switches
- [Surge Protection](https://localemergencyelectrician.com/services/surge-protection): Whole-house surge protectors
- [Smart Home Electrical](https://localemergencyelectrician.com/services/smart-home-electrical): Smart lighting, automation and camera wiring
- [Pool and Hot Tub Electrical](https://localemergencyelectrician.com/services/pool-hot-tub-electrical): Pool and spa wiring and GFCI protection

## Projects and property types
- [New Home Electrical](https://localemergencyelectrician.com/services/new-home-electrical): New construction wiring and panels
- [Home Addition Electrical](https://localemergencyelectrician.com/services/home-addition-electrical): Additions, ADUs, garage conversions
- [Remodeling Electrical](https://localemergencyelectrician.com/services/remodeling-electrical): Kitchen, bathroom and basement remodels
- [Commercial Electrical](https://localemergencyelectrician.com/services/commercial-electrical): Offices, retail and commercial spaces
- [Multifamily Electrical](https://localemergencyelectrician.com/services/multifamily-electrical): Apartments, condos, meter banks, common areas
